content:
lina: FYI after 16:10 UTC rollout (release-5.2.0) we see embeddings.p95 jump in na-west from ~110ms -> ~820ms. Deploy was 6m ago. dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/na-west/embeds

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: embeddings.p95@na-west=820ms (>500ms). Autorevert policy=enabled but change-window active. Recommended: targeted canary rollback or regional pin.

omar: quick traces show increased kv cache misses + one large tenant burst (tenant=gamma). Could be client-side change.

rachel: we should avoid full rollback until we confirm it's the release. Suggest per-tenant reroute + regional 20m pin to buy time.

ops-lead: agree. Lina, you have authority to apply a 20m regional pin and route gamma to 5.1.8. If metrics don't improve in 12m, escalate to full rollback at 23:00 UTC.

lina: running commands now: `redwood route update --tenant gamma --route embeddings --to release-5.1.8 --now` then `redwood pin set --region na-west --route embeddings --version release-5.1.8 --duration 20m`

deploybot: deploybot: Tenant route applied for gamma at 2026-03-22T16:18:12Z. Regional pin applied by lina at 2026-03-22T16:18:40Z. Monitoring.

omar: pinned slice p95 down to ~140ms. gamma tenant now ~130ms. Good signal.

support-bot: support-bot: Notifying CS and Sales: "We routed a subset of traffic to a stable release to mitigate elevated latency. Investigation in progress. No customer data impact."

rachel: opening ticket INF-9012 with traces and the exact deploy diff. Adding quick log: `WARN kvcache.go:198 miss_rate=0.52 tenant=gamma batch=18`

ops-lead: decision: immediate mitigation = tenant reroute + 20m regional pin. Follow-up: if p95 >300ms for >12m after pin expires, perform full rollback to 5.1.8 during the 23:00 UTC window; owners: Lina (exec), Omar (cause), Rachel (ticket/comms).

lina: noted. Keeping thread open until INF-9012 closed.

ops-lead: also add postmortem checklist: include tenant request size histogram, batch distribution, and kernel flag check.

lina: will do. Closing interim actions— will update once pin lifts or we execute rollback.
